refuted.final: REFUTED (residual Info: validator has no self-target-restart warning)
refuted.reason: A self-targeting onDone is an INTERNAL transition by contract; XState v5 makes internal the default with reenter:true as the opt-in, documented three times. With reenter:true every lane re-arms to maxIterations+2 and the #207 stranded hook fires.

All seven vectors reproduce, but they partition into in-process Python (strictly weaker than the premise) and blob-write (which already suffices with no event forgery at all). The external name/shape boundary #195/#203 target holds in every probe. NOT filed as a vulnerability; hardening asks folded into the #203 and #205 comments.
